summary: National Health Investors, Inc. (NHI) filed an 8-K disclosing that the HSR waiting period has been terminated early for its sale of 32 skilled nursing and 3 independent living facilities to NHC/OP, L.P., a wholly-owned subsidiary of National HealthCare Corporation (NHC). The transaction, governed by a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated April 21, 2026, involves property currently leased by the Purchaser Parties from NHI. Closing conditions have been satisfied, with the Review Period ended May 26, 2026, and the transaction expected to close on or about July 1, 2026. No price, premium, or advisor details are provided. Watch for timely closing and any regulatory or financing updates.
